description_en: Queries the semantic node definitions of the current tenant with paging. The Name, ProjectId, and Source fields in the list items can be used for running/deleting nodes, querying run details, and verifying input scope, respectively
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户的语义任务定义。列表项中的 Name、ProjectId 和 Source 可分别复用于运行/删除、运行详情查询和核对输入范围
name: ListSemanticJobs

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than or equal to 0, page 1 is returned
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始；省略或小于等于 0 时按第 1 页处理
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of job definitions per page. If this parameter is not specified or is set to a value less than or equal to 0, the default value 50 is used. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的任务定义数；省略或小于等于 0 时默认 50，最大 200
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description_en: The standard response for paging query of node definitions. Each item in Data.SemanticJobs is a node definition that is active for subsequent runs or queries
schema.description_zh: 分页查询任务定义的标准响应。Data.SemanticJobs 中每项都是可用于后续运行或查询的任务定义

Data.description_en: The paginated result of job definitions. Use the Name field of a list item to run, delete, query run records, or download results. Use the ProjectId field to query run details, logs, or stop a run
Data.description_zh: 任务定义分页结果。使用列表项 Name 运行、删除、查询运行记录或下载结果；使用 ProjectId 查询运行详情、日志或停止运行

PageNumber.description_en: The page number returned, starting from 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 本次返回的页码，从 1 开始

PageSize.description_en: The number of job definitions per page returned
PageSize.description_zh: 本次返回的每页任务定义数

items.description_en: A saved semantic job definition. The fields have the same meanings as those in the Data parameter of CreateSemanticJob
items.description_zh: 一个已保存的语义任务定义，其字段含义与 CreateSemanticJob 的 Data 一致

Creator.description_en: The user identifier of the semantic job creator
Creator.description_zh: 语义任务创建者的用户标识

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳

GmtModified.description_en: The last modification time, expressed as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 最近修改时间，单位为毫秒的 Unix 时间戳

Id.description_en: The internal unique ID of the job definition
Id.description_zh: 任务定义的内部唯一 ID

Name.description_en: The job name. Used for RunSemanticJob, DeleteSemanticJob, ListSemanticJobRuns, and DownloadSemanticResults
Name.description_zh: 任务名称；用于 RunSemanticJob、DeleteSemanticJob、ListSemanticJobRuns 和 DownloadSemanticResults

ProjectId.description_en: The workspace ID to which the job belongs. Used for GetSemanticJobDetail, GetSemanticJobLog, and KillSemanticJob
ProjectId.description_zh: 任务所属工作空间 ID；用于 GetSemanticJobDetail、GetSemanticJobLog 和 KillSemanticJob

ReferenceFileIds.description_en: The list of uploaded file IDs associated with the job
ReferenceFileIds.description_zh: 任务关联的上传文件 ID 列表

items.description_en: The optional list of uploaded reference file IDs
items.description_zh: 可选的已上传参考文件 ID 列表

ReferenceFileUris.description_en: The list of external reference file URIs associated with the job
ReferenceFileUris.description_zh: 任务关联的外部参考文件 URI 列表

items.description_en: The optional list of accessible reference file URIs
items.description_zh: 可选的可访问参考文件 URI 列表

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group identifier used when running this job
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 运行本任务时使用的资源组标识

Source.description_en: The input datasource config saved with the node. This configuration determines the analysis scope at runtime
Source.description_zh: 任务保存的输入数据源配置；运行时据此选择分析范围

Type.description_en: The Source.type data source type saved with the job
Type.description_zh: 任务保存的 Source.type 数据源类型

UserId.description_en: The user identifier of the semantic job creator
UserId.description_zh: 语义任务创建者的用户标识

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of job definitions that meet the conditions in the current tenant
TotalCount.description_zh: 当前租户内符合条件的任务定义总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志和排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
